description: Sandbox: move money from the merchant balance into an agent wallet. The wallet's balance is the agent's total spend limit.

amount.description: Amount to move, in whole XOF (F CFA). Integer, no decimals: 5000 = 5 000 F CFA.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this business action (e.g. order-1042). Reuse the SAME key when retrying; a new key creates a new operation.

name: xaalis_fund_agent_wallet
title: Fund an agent wallet (sandbox)
